description: omp's parent turn is waiting on two task subagents it spawned ('waiting on 2 jobs', a Subagents roster, a spinner in place of π on the status row). omp counts the whole turn as busy while it waits on its jobs (spinner title, collab `busy`), so the parent is running with two running workers. Its 'waiting on … jobs' row lingers after the jobs finish, so it cannot mark a wait by itself. Real capture of omp 18.4.12 installed via bun (so tmux reports current_command=bun), 160 columns, trailing whitespace trimmed.
